# Server Setup Checklist

*Generated by NOTIXNODE — Review and customize for your server*

## Pre-Installation

- [ ] Choose server software (Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge)
- [ ] Verify Java version (17+ for 1.18+, 21+ for 1.20.5+)
- [ ] Allocate sufficient RAM (see Resource Calculator)
- [ ] Configure firewall/port forwarding (25565 TCP/UDP)
- [ ] Set up domain/DDNS pointing to server IP
- [ ] Prepare start script with Aikar's JVM flags

## Installation

- [ ] Download server JAR from official source
- [ ] Create server directory
- [ ] Run once to generate eula.txt
- [ ] Accept EULA (`eula=true`)
- [ ] Configure `server.properties`:
  - [ ] `server-port=25565`
  - [ ] `motd=Your Server Name`
  - [ ] `gamemode=survival`
  - [ ] `difficulty=normal`
  - [ ] `max-players=20`
  - [ ] `online-mode=true`
  - [ ] `enable-command-block=false`
  - [ ] `view-distance=10`
  - [ ] `simulation-distance=10`
- [ ] Configure Paper/Purpur/Spigot configs:
  - [ ] `paper.yml` - optimization settings
  - [ ] `spigot.yml` - entity/performance settings
  - [ ] `bukkit.yml` - spawn/performance settings
- [ ] Start server and verify clean startup

## Plugins/Mods

- [ ] Install plugin manager (if applicable)
- [ ] Core plugins:
  - [ ] EssentialsX (commands, economy, homes)
  - [ ] LuckPerms (permissions)
  - [ ] WorldEdit (building)
  - [ ] WorldGuard (region protection)
  - [ ] DiscordSRV (Discord integration)
- [ ] Anti-cheat (if needed)
- [ ] Economy/Vault (if needed)
- [ ] Chat/formatting plugins
- [ ] Backup plugin
- [ ] Configure each plugin's config.yml

## Permissions

- [ ] Set up LuckPerms groups (default, member, donor, mod, admin, owner)
- [ ] Configure inheritance hierarchy
- [ ] Set prefixes/suffixes for each group
- [ ] Assign permissions per group
- [ ] Test permission inheritance

## World Setup

- [ ] Generate or import world
- [ ] Set spawn point
- [ ] Create spawn protection region (WorldGuard)
- [ ] Set up resource world (if applicable)
- [ ] Configure world border

## Discord/Community

- [ ] Create Discord server
- [ ] Configure DiscordSRV
- [ ] Set up verification/role sync
- [ ] Create announcement channels
- [ ] Set up staff channels

## Testing

- [ ] Test connection from external IP
- [ ] Verify all commands work
- [ ] Test permissions for each group
- [ ] Test economy/shop systems
- [ ] Load test with multiple players
- [ ] Monitor TPS, RAM, CPU under load

## Go Live

- [ ] Final restart
- [ ] Post announcement
- [ ] Staff online for launch
- [ ] Monitor console for errors
